other.tags: Bossa nova. Nylon string acoustic guitar plays syncopated jazz chords with a steady thumb-plucked bassline on beats 1 and 3. A shaker maintains a constant sixteenth-note pattern. The percussion features a woodblock or rimshot playing a 3-2 son clave pattern. A melodic flute enters with legato phrasing, utilizing vibrato on sustained notes and occasional trills. The arrangement is minimalist, focusing on the interplay between the rhythmic guitar comping and the breathy flute melody. 120 BPM. Key of C Major. 4/4 time signature.

bass.tags: Hard rock. Distorted electric guitar plays a syncopated, palm-muted riff centered on E. A second electric guitar provides sustained power chords and melodic lead fills with high-gain saturation. The bass guitar follows the root notes of the guitar riff with a gritty, overdriven tone. Drums feature a heavy, compressed kick and a crisp snare with a short plate reverb. The arrangement follows a linear progression with a focus on rhythmic interplay between the kick drum and the muted guitar chugging. 120 BPM. 4/4 time signature. Key of E minor.

drums.tags: Percussion solo featuring a high-pitched, resonant woodblock and a dry, low-tuned kick drum. The woodblock performs a syncopated, repetitive rhythmic pattern consisting of two eighth notes followed by a quarter note rest. The kick drum enters on the third beat of every second measure with a single, muffled strike. The recording features a natural room reverb with a short decay. The tempo is 100 BPM in 4/4 time. The woodblock hits are consistent in velocity and timbre throughout the sequence.
